items.headline: $AERO Launches as Aerodrome & Velodrome Merge on 7 Chains
items.summary: Aerodrome and Velodrome have merged into one DEX, $AERO, now live across Ethereum, Base, OP Mainnet, Arbitrum and more. $VELO converts at 0.044 AERO, with locked positions becoming sAERO.

items.headline: $KIMCHI Coin Minted by 3-Hour-Old Wallet, Fees Rigged
items.summary: A fresh wallet minted $KIMCHI, sniped 79% of supply for ~$9,300 and hard-coded one address as the permanent creator-fee recipient. Pump.fun's own page labels that address 'Kimchi.'

items.headline: $CARDS: Collector Crypt Posts Record $24.3M Day
items.summary: Collector Crypt users ripped 123,425 packs in a single day, with $24.3M in gross receipts — roughly 13% of the trailing 30-day pack-sales total in 24 hours.

items.headline: $OBOL Urges Immediate Charon Upgrade After Key Compromise
items.summary: $OBOL told node operators to patch Charon immediately after a CA key compromise. The distributed-validator network secures over 422,862 ETH in mainnet cluster balances.

items.headline: $PENDLE Expands One-Click Looping to Tokenized Stocks
items.summary: $PENDLE now offers one-click looping on yield assets and tokenized stocks, with stock longs on Base powered by Aave loans. Loop fees on non-PT positions are waived through Dec 31.
